name: io.github.ArionPay-Dev/arionpay-mcp
title: ArionPay
description: Search the ArionPay crypto payment docs, and create and check invoices for your store. Payments go straight to your own wallet.

environmentVariables.name: ARIONPAY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your store API key (pk_...). Leave out for the docs tools only.

environmentVariables.name: ARIONPAY_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Your store API secret (sk_...). Needed together with the API key.

environmentVariables.name: ARIONPAY_LIVE
environmentVariables.description: true allows real invoices when asked for. Default: test invoices only.

environmentVariables.name: ARIONPAY_MAX_AMOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Largest real invoice, in the invoice's currency. Default 1000.

environmentVariables.name: ARIONPAY_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: true leaves out every tool that creates or changes something.
